def f(value,offset=2):
    value+=offset
    value*=3
    return value
print(f(4),f(value=5,offset=1))

def f(value,saved=None):
    saved=locals()
    value=99
    return saved,value
print(f(7))

def keep(value):
    def value(): return value
    return value
f=keep(7)
keep(9)
print(f() is f)

def f(value):
    del value
    value=9
    return value
print(f(7),f(value=8))

def f(a,b=2): return a,b
f.__defaults__=(9,)
print(f(1),f(1,3))

def old(value): return value+1
def newer(value): return value+100
f=old
def argument():
    global f
    f=newer
    return 3
print(f(argument()),f(3))

def keep(value):
    def read(): return value
    return read
a=[]
one=keep(a)
two=keep([])
a.append(7)
print(one() is a,one(),two())

def f(value): return locals()['value']
print(f(9))
def g(*values,**named): return values,named
print(g(1,2,x=3))
